errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis labels are set for July of each year, but the figure shows labels for every six months, alternating between July (07/YYYY) and January (01/YYYY+1).
The description states that the purple line has a dip to approximately 30 around the year 2017. However, the chart shows the dip around early 2017 is at approximately 50.
